items.summary: Update the backend prediction flow so that for each cutoff record, the system includes that record in the returned predictions only when predicted_rank is less than or equal to that record’s closing_rank (i.e., filter out non-eligible records instead of returning all evaluated records).

Adjust the predictions UI to reflect that the results list contains only eligible colleges (predicted_rank <= closing_rank) and ensure the table renders correctly with the filtered results returned by the backend.
